title: Mauritian Sega Tutorial- Basic steps with Angel

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains basic movements step by step with clear verbal descriptions. She demonstrates the techniques calmly while speaking directly to the camera.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to Mauritian Sega and basic steps

cues: Move your hips side to side
metaphors: As though you're kicking off sand
Or trying to wipe something off your foot
safety: Remember to breathe because if you're doing it right you'll probably be tired afterwards

steps_taught.name: Hip movements
steps_taught.description: Moving hips side to side or in a circular motion.

steps_taught.name: Feet movements
steps_taught.description: Scraping the back foot along the floor like kicking off sand.

what_works: Breaking down body parts separately before combining them
what_hinders: Music overlays can make verbal instructions harder to hear at times

quotes.text: Start by moving your hips side to side.
Scrape it along the floor as though you're kicking off sand.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates hip movement side to side and circular motion facing front and back.
Teacher demonstrates scraping foot motion with ball of foot on the floor.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact friction or pressure on the floor

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the dance strictly by body isolations (hips first, then feet, then hands) before putting everything together.
